CustomField.description: Indicates if the Account is New Business or Expansion, and SMB, Commercial, Mid-Market, or Enterprise based on Account Spend and Number of Employees. https://app.asana.com/0/1156951077655217/1159469601995612/f
CustomField.formula:
IF(NumberOfEmployees<50,"SMB",
IF(AND(Total_Account_ARR__c<5000, AND(NumberOfEmployees>=50, NumberOfEmployees<500)),"Commercial New Business",
IF(AND(Total_Account_ARR__c>=5000, AND(NumberOfEmployees>=50, NumberOfEmployees<500)),"Commercial Expansion",
IF(AND(Total_Account_ARR__c<25000, AND(NumberOfEmployees>=500, NumberOfEmployees<2000)),"Mid-Market New Business",
IF(AND(Total_Account_ARR__c>=25000, AND(NumberOfEmployees>=500, NumberOfEmployees<2000)),"Mid-Market Expansion",
IF(AND(Total_Account_ARR__c<50000, NumberOfEmployees>=2000),"Enterprise New Business",
IF(AND(Total_Account_ARR__c>=50000, NumberOfEmployees>=2000),"Enterprise Expansion","")))))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set based on the Total Account ARR and Number of Employees.
CustomField.label: Account State
